text:
jeff: Heads-up — last pass for v1.8.3 changelog one-liners. Cutoff in 30m (16:30 PT). Please add one concise line to your PRs: single sentence, component tag, and PR number. Example: "perf: reduce kv-cache memory by 12% (PR #4321)".
anika: Do we have canonical component tags anywhere?
jeff: Yes — use one of: runtime, api, console, docs, infra, perf, platform. lowercase only.
mike: Can we include jira links or long notes?
jeff: Keep changelog lines user-facing and short. Put long details in PR bodies or release notes. No internal links in the changelog file. Only include PR number.
sasha: changelog-lint is failing on my PR because it touches infra + runtime. What should I pick?
jeff: Pick the primary component. If it's truly cross-cutting, use "platform".
release-bot: changelog-lint: PR #4399 failed: missing component tag. Run `tools/changelog-lint --fix PR-4399` or add a line matching the one-liner format.
sasha: Ran the fixer and pushed. Thanks.
mike: Small formatting q: bullets or comma-separated entries in the aggregated file?
jeff: One bullet per line please. No paragraphs. Keep it machine- and human-friendly.
release-bot: reminder: cutoff in 15 minutes.
dev-bot: release-branch v1.8.x CI: ✅ all checks green. Merge queue open.
mike: Pushed my one-liner.
jeff: If you miss the cutoff, tag @jeff with the PR and we'll triage whether it can land in the patch or must wait. Thanks! :thumbsup:
